parsed.post: Discarding the last run (0.9454); it was significantly worse than my current best (0.8938). The increase in learning rate likely caused instability. I am reverting to my best config and will instead try reducing the learning rate slightly to find a more stable, higher-performance peak.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.02 to stabilize training and potentially achieve better convergence after the failed high-LR experiment.
